title: Thank-You and Follow-Up Completion
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`volunteer:shift`), donations (`donation:gift`), community events (`community:event`), mutual-aid requests (`mutualaid:request`), impact metrics (`impact:metric`).
app: Volunteering and community telemetry — volunteer-hours trackers, donation receipts, mutual-aid request boards, and community-event calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:event
| stats sum(eval(if(followup_sent="yes",1,0))) as followups, count as events by organizer
| eval followup_pct=round(100*followups/events,1)
| sort - followup_pct
description: Measures whether thank-you notes and follow-up messages are consistently sent after events or campaigns.
value: Follow-up is where appreciation turns into retention, especially in volunteer-driven communities.
implementation: Track post-event follow-up state on `community:event` records and calculate completion percentage by organizer.
visualization: Table of organizers with follow-up completion percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It compares whether people are being thanked and followed up with after community events.
